entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Kettle Rock, Saltmere port office. We have your arrival. Keep the passage lit, and report anything the last crew left behind.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Kettle Rock, Saltmere port office. We have your arrival. Keep the passage lit, and report anything the last crew left behind.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Owen Teague lost his hearing in the war. Sharpest eyes on the coast. Point, and he'll follow.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: One rule on the Kettle above all the others. Two keepers. Always together after dark.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: The Board will tell you it's the machinery. Needs two pairs of hands. Well. It does.
entries.delivery: dry, a beat too long before Well

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Job board's by the door. Start with what's leaking. There's always something leaking.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Saltmere port office. Check the engine before the next convoy.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Night three. I've a broadcast for the ships, and I need your radio for it.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Worst of it's coming tonight. Two ships, close together. You'll be busy.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Last night of the storm. The Providence sails at midnight. Two hundred and twelve aboard.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Kettle Rock, harbor here. Ship due in five minutes, and you've a pipe gone on Floor One. Move.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Water's coming in on Floor One. Pipe joint by the pump. Take the wrench from the bench.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Three bolts on that joint. Fit the wrench and turn them right. Righty tighty.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: One bolt left. Keep at it.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That'll hold. Good work.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: The pump clears the water, but only if it's got power. Check the panel on Floor Two.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That pressure valve takes two. One of you on each wheel. Turn together, slow.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Pressure valve takes two. Point Teague at the far wheel, then turn together.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Fill her from the can first. Tilt it right over the cap.
entries.trigger: at generator, tank empty, idle 15 s

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Now prime it. Pump the primer till it goes stiff.
entries.trigger: tank full, not primed, idle 15 s

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Choke closed for a cold start. Then pull the cord. Hard.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: She won't catch first go. Pull again.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Power is back. Check your partner, then the remaining work.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Power panel's on the wall, Floor Two. Not enough for everything. Pick what matters.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Radio's on Floor Four. Turn the dial till my voice comes in clear.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Tonight's code is on the telegram in the House. One of you reads it, one sends it.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Code's on the telegram in the House. Send Teague for it, or fetch it yourself.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Got you loud and clear, Kettle Rock. I'll pass the word to the ships.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Beacon wheel's on Floor Four. Turn the beam onto her lights and hold it there.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Keep it on her. She has to see you the whole way past the rocks.
entries.trigger: first time on target in a window

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: You're drifting off her. Bring it back.
entries.trigger: off target >3 s in danger window

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Something's torn that pipe open again. Follow the water, Floor One.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: The engine is losing fuel. Check the tank on Floor Two.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: You've lost a circuit. There's a cable down on Floor Two. Join it at the junction box.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That's the circuit back. Lights on Two.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Your light's fouled. There's muck on the glass. Get a rag on it.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That's it. She's shining clean.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: There you are. Wire was cut. That wasn't the storm.
entries.trigger: radio wire rejoined; HM silent while cut

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: If there's marks on that tank, they're old. Get her running.
entries.trigger: player within 1.5 m of tank handprints

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Take a lantern from the marked hook. You will need it while the engine is out.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Oil's dear out there. Keep the wick low, and hang it up while you work.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Your lamp's running low. There's one can of oil on the shelf, Floor Two.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Water's halfway to the engine. Get that pump running.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Water's at the machinery! Pump, now, or you lose the power!

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Ship's coming. Beacon first. The water can wait a minute. Not much more.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Your light's dark and there's a ship on the approach!

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: See those lights? That's the Mary Ellen, coal for the city. She'll pass well clear tonight.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Lights to the south. There's a ship making for the passage.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: She's in close by the rocks. Get your beam on her. Now.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Ship clear of the rocks. Keep watch for the next signal.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: No. No, she's on the Kettles.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Nothing you can do for her now. Keep the light. There'll be others.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: You two are on different floors. Don't stay that way long.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Teague's lost sight of you. Get back to him.
entries.trigger: Owen lost sight 30 s in darkness

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That's better. Stay where you can see each other.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Kettle Rock, listen to me. Get somewhere it can't see you. Hide. Now.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Don't move. Don't breathe. It'll pass.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: You're still there. Good. Stay together. I mean it this time.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: The storm bell, Floor Two. Ring it. It can't abide the bell.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Flare pistol's on the bench in the House. One shot. Make it count.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Keeper? Keeper! Get up. You're on Floor One. Get up.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Your partner's down on Floor One. Get to them. Take their hand.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: There. Both of you. Don't let go of each other again.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Walter Brennick kept that engine nineteen years. Never lost a night. Till this summer.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Same as August. The fuel, then a cable. Same order.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: It's not the machinery. It's never been the machinery. Just don't be alone in the dark.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: My son was stationed on the Kettle. Tom. He has been missing for a week.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Tom wrote about something at the bottom of the stairs. I thought he was tired.
entries.trigger: N4 tall figure sighting or radio log read

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: If you see Walter, it's not Walter. Do you understand me? It is not Walter.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: There's a thing I should've told you on the first night.
entries.trigger: N5 first calm after first ship

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: The Lucy Gale. I told Walter to light her through, whatever it took. He went down alone.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Tom called me. Said Walter was on the stairs. The Board says no boats in the dark. I didn't send one.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: I'll not give that order again. Not for any ship. You keep each other first.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Why do you think I sent you a man who can't hear it?

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: You read the bottom of that telegram? Good. I meant it.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That's the watch done. Get some sleep, both of you. Bunks are on Three.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That's the watch done. Get some sleep. Teague will take the first hour.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Not yet. There's still work on the board.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Morning, Kettle Rock. You made it through. Saltmere thanks you.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Not bad for a first night. Get some breakfast in you.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Water's in the machinery. The light's gone. We'll take the watch again.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: We lost her. We'll go again from the start of the watch.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Kettle Rock? I can't raise either of you. Kettle Rock?

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Right. Again. Same storm, same ships. You know it better now.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That's her. The Providence. Every light she has is lit. She's trusting you.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: She's through. Two hundred and twelve. She's through.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: First light. I'm coming out myself. Board be damned.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: Look at the city. A candle in every window. That's for you.

entries.speaker: HM
entries.text: That's how the night goes on the Kettle. There are five of them.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: It's quieter without the engine.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: Your little lamp is getting smaller.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: That bolt was tight before.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: It drinks so much, your engine.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: Eleven weeks.

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: You left the other one upstairs.
entries.trigger: co-op alone lower floor dark N3+

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: You left the quiet one upstairs.
entries.trigger: solo Owen lost sight 20 s N3+

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: Where is the other one now?

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: Forty-one. Forty-two.

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: Walter used to count these stairs.

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: Breathing is loud, in a cupboard.
entries.trigger: hidden, within 2 m, not holding breath

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: You'll come out. They always come out.

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: Tom hid under that bunk.

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: Run, then.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: So many lights on her. So many.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: Thank you.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: There. That's better.

entries.speaker: M
entries.text: Margaret kept a lamp too.

entries.speaker: L
entries.text: She dropped that. Give it back.

entries.speaker: L
entries.text: [humming]
entries.delivery: Eternal Father, Strong to Save, first line, distant

entries.speaker: L
entries.text: It's dry up there.

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: A ship's a ship, boy.

entries.speaker: W
entries.text: He stood in the light until it went out.
